summary: A very large number of families left the South over six decades, each by its own decision.
realLife: About six million Black Americans moved from the South to Northern, Midwestern and Western states from the 1910s to the 1970s, escaping racial violence and seeking work and schools.
inGame: needs: a migration wave in the history run that a moved record can cite. Voice: plain and respectful, never dry.

turns.what: A family stays in the South through the migration, by choice or by necessity.
